description: The plot illustrates the comparison of loss values between a vanilla Transformer model and the proposed SepLLM model as a function of computational cost, measured in TFLOPs (trillion floating-point operations). The x-axis, labeled “TFLOPs,” spans from 0.00 to 1.25 × 10⁹ with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 0.25 × 10⁹. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.40 to 2.75 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Two lines are plotted: “Vanilla” (purple line with triangle markers, solid style) and “SepLLM” (red line with circular markers, solid style). The vanilla model starts at approximately 2.76 loss at 0 TFLOPs and gradually decreases to about 2.50 loss at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. The SepLLM model begins at approximately 2.74 loss and declines more steeply, reaching about 2.47 loss at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. A green dashed horizontal line at loss = 2.50 and a green vertical bracket between 1.00 and 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs indicate that SepLLM achieves the same loss as vanilla at 1.28× lower computational cost. Both lines show a consistent downward trend, with SepLLM consistently maintaining a lower loss across the entire range of TFLOPs.
